notes:
Launcher 19.3 is here.

- MuMu and LDPlayer now use the 64-bit arm64-v8a payload; GameLoop keeps the 32-bit armeabi-v7a payload.
- The launcher detects the game ABI and logs whether armeabi-v7a or arm64-v8a was selected.
- The 64-bit payload now requires the launcher lease session, like the 32-bit payload.
